title: SCA_Motor Vehicle Mechanic
description:
The Wheeled Vehicle Mechanic is responsible for the inspection, maintenance, and repair of wheeled vehicles and associated systems. This role ensures operational readiness and safety of vehicles used in transportation, logistics, or tactical operations.

Key Responsibilities:
• Vehicle Inspection & Diagnostics
o Conduct routine and scheduled inspections of wheeled vehicles.
o Use diagnostic tools and software to identify mechanical and electrical faults.
• Preventive Maintenance
o Perform oil changes, fluid checks, filter replacements, and lubrication.
o Maintain service records and ensure vehicles meet operational standards.
• Mechanical Repairs
o Repair or replace components such as engines, transmissions, brakes, axles, and suspension systems.
o Conduct overhauls and rebuilds of major vehicle systems when necessary.
• Electrical System Maintenance
o Troubleshoot and repair lighting, ignition, and charging systems.
o Replace batteries, alternators, and wiring harnesses.
• Tire and Wheel Services
o Inspect, rotate, and replace tires.
o Perform wheel alignment and balancing.
• Hydraulic and Pneumatic Systems
o Maintain and repair hydraulic brakes, steering systems, and lift mechanisms.
o Replace seals, hoses, and fittings as needed.
• Field Support (if applicable)
o Provide mobile repair services in field or remote environments.
o Recover and tow disabled vehicles.
• Safety & Compliance
o Adhere to safety protocols and wear appropriate PPE.
o Ensure vehicles comply with environmental and operational regulations.
• Tool & Inventory Management
o Maintain tools and equipment in good working condition.
o Track parts usage and assist with inventory control.

Qualifications:
• High school diploma or equivalent; technical certification preferred.
• Proven experience as a vehicle mechanic (military or civilian).
• Knowledge of diesel and gasoline engines, hydraulics, and electrical systems.
• Ability to read technical manuals and schematics.
• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
• Valid driver's license; CDL or military license may be required.

title: Assembler
description:
Job Summary:
We are seeking a highly skilled Solder assembler to join our team, specializing in advanced rework on circuit card assemblies and knowledge of mechanical assembly related to circuit cards. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in soldering and rework techniques, with the ability to work on complex electronic assemblies. If you have a keen eye for detail, excellent hand-eye coordination, and a passion for precision electronics work, we encourage you to apply.

Key Responsibilities:
• Perform advanced rework on circuit card assemblies, including but not limited to:
• BGA (Ball Grid Array) reballing and replacement
• QFN (Quad Flat No-Lead) and other leadless package rework
• High-density connector rework and repair
• Complex SMT (Surface Mount Technology) component replacement
• Through-hole and surface mount technology (SMT) components
• Fine pitch and high-density components
• Utilize various soldering techniques, including hand soldering and reflow soldering
• Uses microscope to verify correct part placement and orientation
• Inspect and troubleshoot assemblies to identify defects and areas for improvement
• Develop and implement rework procedures for new and existing products
• Collaborate with engineering teams to resolve design and manufacturing issues
• Perform mechanical assembly operations, including:
• Installing stand-offs, spacers, and other hardware
• Assembling and aligning complex mechanical components
• Using adhesives, epoxies, and other bonding agents
• Maintain a clean and organized workspace, adhering to safety and quality standards

Requirements:
• 5+ years of experience in soldering and rework, with a focus on advanced techniques
• Strong understanding of electronics assembly and repair principles
• Proficiency with soldering equipment, including but not limited to:
• Soldering irons and stations
• Reflow ovens and soldering machines
• Experience with inspection and testing equipment, such as microscopes and X-ray machines
• Excellent hand-eye coordination, fine motor skills, and attention to detail
• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, meeting production deadlines and quality standards
• Strong communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams
• IPC (Institute for Printed Circuits) certification in soldering and rework (e.g., IPC-A-610, IPC-7711/7721)
• Experience with automated optical inspection (AOI) and x-ray inspection (AXI) systems
• Assemble and solder electronic components, including:
• Through-hole and surface mount technology (SMT) component

description:

Flying probe/high power test experience

Familiarity with Radar Systems

title: Fire Protection Design Engineer
description:
Fire Protection Design Engineer
(Overview)
Reporting to the Facilities Engineering Manager, as a Fire Protection Design Engineer you will be responsible for ensuring quality and timely deliveries of our Fire Protection system along with additional services to customers. The design engineer requires an in-depth understanding of current Fire Protection design standards and industry processes. As a licensed Fire Protection Engineer, you will be the primary contact for customer facing project work. This key position works closely with AHJ’S and clients to ensure projects are compliant and being completed as assigned. The Fire Protection design engineer is fully responsible and accountable for the ﬁnal design content and document generation to support the Fire Protection system. The right candidate for this position can meet required deadlines and communicate effectively with customers and jurisdictional authorities.
Responsibilities
• Attend project Kick-Off meetings, facilitate design reviews, provide construction inspection (as necessary), and test/commission system deliveries
• Plan, direct, and oversee fire protection engineering activities including project execution, testing, and recommend operational spares. This will span to all three locations on the Deep Space Network; including overseas sites
• Conduct Fire protection engineering inspections, studies, design, and calculations to meet functional design requirements
• Responsible for engineering and/or design function on specific projects, delivering effective and cost-efficient alternatives and solutions for the project.
• Design, sustain, and provide analysis for new and existing private fire service mains, fire pumping and distribution system, fire suppression system, gas extinguishing system, fire alarm system, and prepare technical specifications
• Meet with jurisdictional authorities and clients as needed to resolve compliance questions
• Conduct Fire protection engineering inspection, studies, design, and complex calculations
• Create Requisitions for Purchase Order approval and payment to vendors.
• Complete site surveys, identify code issues, and offer compliant solutions
• Work with Cognizant Development Engineers (CDEs) and/or field personnel to ensure quality and timely delivery of our services
• Maintain and update appropriate technical documentation
• Provide remote technical support as necessary to perform field service and additional assistance as required
• Analyze and recommend upgrade/expansion strategies
• Provide code and standard references, as well as document research, reports, and interpretations for fire protection applications.
• Continuously review, and maintain a working knowledge of, changing codes, standards, industry specifications and practices to ensure compliance.
• Perform interpretation and application of local, state, federal requirements, and regulations relative to all aspects of fire protection and life safety both local and at our overseas facilities
• Perform all work as necessary to conform to quality control guidelines (includes compliance with requirements outlined in applicable regulations such as: OSHA,NASA, NFPA, NPR, and NEC, etc. as well as following procedures as outlined in the Installation, Technical, Operations, and Safety Manuals)
• Develop and deliver reports to clients on recommended updates to ensure compliance and /or operational functionality of fire monitoring, suppression, and/or life safety systems
• Attend and participate in local and national professional organizations, such as SFPE and NFPA
• Provide peer reviews of colleagues’ work product
• Project management skills for managing internal projects as well as external client needs
• Visit construction sites or frequent travel with overnight stay
Required Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree, or higher, in engineering technology or sciences preferred or any other degree, specialized training, or experience, that makes the individual uniquely qualiﬁed to perform the job responsibilities, preferably Fire Protection Engineering
• Minimum of 8-10 years related work experience with Fire Protection detailed design. Highly preferred 10+ years’ experience.
• Fire Protection Engineering License by examination issued by any state in the United States
• Experience in interpreting client request and apply design standards to work product
• Possess certifications, training, and working knowledge of NFPA codes and standards
• Ability to multi-task, work with minimal supervision, follow written and oral instructions, show attention to detail, and demonstrate problem-solving skills
• Experienced in Plan Reviews
• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including oral presentation skills
• Prepare and present technical audits, reports, and exhibits
• Managing day-to-day contacts with external clients while utilizing experience and technology to meet expectations
• Experience in using AutoCAD, and a fire sprinkler program to design fire alarm, fire suppression, and life safety systems in AutoCAD
• Visit complexes, including international travel or frequent travel with overnight stay
• Certified Fire Protection Specialist, preferred
• Working knowledge of Fire, Life Safety, Building Codes, and NFPA Standards
• Possess certifications, training, and working knowledge of NFPA codes and standards including NFPA13, 2001, 70, and 72.
Desired Qualifications
• Have a demonstrated track record of successful project management
• Strong Interpersonal, analytical and communication skills
• Experience working on multiple projects simultaneously
• Ability to work on a high functioning team
• Flexible and able to think quickly working to resolve design issues and makes decisions.
• Ability to manage time and meet deadlines and budgets
• Working competency with MS Office Suite & MS Project software

SECURITY CLEARANCE:
This position requires the candidate to be able to obtain a trusted background check and pass a National Criminal Information Check (NCIC). In order to obtain a clearance, you need to be a US Citizen and show proof of citizenship.

title: Technical LEad
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
We are seeking a Technical Lead to guide a large-scale assessment of an existing Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) environment and its potential migration to Oracle ERP Cloud. The Technical Lead will partner with resident subject matter experts, the Functional Lead, and the program team to evaluate the current footprint, analyze technical complexity, and recommend a roadmap for transition.

Responsibilities
  • Assessment & Discovery
    • Lead technical assessment of the current Oracle EBS environment, including integrations, extensions, reports, data, and customizations.
    • Identify technical dependencies and potential challenges in moving to Oracle ERP Cloud.
    • Evaluate module coverage for Field Service, Supply Chain Management, Advanced Planning, and Financials.
  • Cloud Readiness & Gap Analysis
    • Map existing EBS capabilities to Oracle ERP Cloud functionality.
    • Assess data migration requirements and tooling (e.g., FBDI, OTBI, integration methods).
    • Document gaps and propose technical options (reconfiguration, extension, or retirement).
  • Technical Architecture & Roadmap
    • Define high-level architecture for Oracle ERP Cloud adoption, including integration and reporting strategy.
    • Provide input on security, identity management, and compliance considerations.
    • Recommend migration sequencing and technical approach for deployment.
  • Collaboration & Leadership
    • Work closely with the Functional Lead to align technical findings with business processes.
    • Mentor team members and provide technical guidance to SMEs and program staff.
    • Communicate assessment findings to program leadership and contribute to executive-level deliverables.

Required Qualifications
  • 10+ years of experience with Oracle E-Business Suite (technical and integration background).
  • 3+ years of experience with Oracle ERP Cloud / Oracle Fusion Applications.
  • Strong understanding of EBS modules: Field Service, Supply Chain, Advanced Planning, and Financials.
  • Hands-on expertise with integrations, data migration, reporting (BI Publisher, OTBI), and security.
  • Proven experience in leading cloud readiness assessments and migration planning.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, especially in complex federal or large enterprise environments.
